essays.title: Seven boxes, one burger
essays.standfirst: The same sandwich, packed in Spain, Poland, Hong Kong, Italy, Belgium, the UK and the USA. Most of the box never changes; the interesting part is what does.

essays.title: From offers to origins
essays.standfirst: Tray liners are the largest printed surface a customer handles. Over twenty years, the archive’s liners stop selling deals and start explaining where the food comes from.

essays.title: Brown paper, borrowed characters
essays.standfirst: For most of the 1990s, a British McDonald’s bag was either plain kraft paper printed in one colour or a full-colour advert for someone else’s characters.
